pointer_wheel: owner is nearest ancestor under pointer marked data-scroll-owner for requested axis; CSS overscroll-behavior:contain prevents chaining at boundary
keyboard: owner is nearest focused scroll surface; otherwise current workbench primary surface
touch: owner is gesture-origin scroll surface after movement disambiguation; ownership does not transfer mid-gesture
rules: horizontal delta is offered only to horizontal-capable owner
autocomplete popup is a scroll owner while open/hovered/focused
